job.prompt: Create a realistic industrial B2B website hero image for a Taiwan-based professional hand tool manufacturer. Show a clean, organized tool assembly and inspection environment with torque wrenches, insulated screwdrivers, socket sets, and packaged toolkit cases visible in the foreground. The scene should feel export-ready, professional, and technically disciplined. Lighting should be crisp and neutral, with deep navy and steel-blue color cues, subtle orange accents, no cinematic effects, no workers staring at camera, no exaggerated sparks, no fantasy factory elements. Composition should leave negative space for a website headline on the left.
